title: Rabbi Elazar ben Pila (or Piavi)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Mishnah Tahorot 7:9: he said, “Why does Rabbi Akiva declare it impure? Because women are inquisitive: a woman is suspected of uncovering her neighbor's pot to find out what she is cooking.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Mishnah spells out מפני מה, “why,” resolving מ״מ here. The context is curiosity about a neighbor’s cooking; “inquisitive” conveys that sense of גרגרניות. Hyman abbreviates the fuller Mishnah quotation.

The complete consulted Mishnah Tahorot 7:9 names Rabbi Elazar ben Pila and spells out מפני מה, ‘why.’ Its cooking-pot context supports ‘inquisitive.’ Hyman abbreviates the fuller quotation, including its reference to the sages; his heading’s Pila/Piavi alternative is retained without adding another identity.
